page_title: HOF 0-2 PAU | Hoffenheim v St. Pauli 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Sascha Stegemann has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' 0 - 2 Stunning strike! Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) latches on to a precise through ball from Jackson Irvine before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:2.
90+2' The ball rebounds out to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) replaces Johannes Eggestein.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manolis Saliakas trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:2.
85' Substitution. Valentin Gendrey makes way for Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
85' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Arthur Chaves and he is replaced by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim).
84' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
83' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
82' The attendance is 26199.
80' It is time for a substitution. Robert Wagner (St. Pauli) is on for Oladapo Afolayan.
78' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

76' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the left post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Nikola Vasilj and his brilliant save.
70' Referee Sascha Stegemann has finally had enough of Alexander Blessin and brandishes a yellow card at him!
69' A lofted cross from David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
66' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Alexander Prass is replaced by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Marius Bulter cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) for a tough tackle.
62' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
59' The game is interrupted now, Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:5.
55' The ball is cleared after Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
54' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Haris Tabakovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
50' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Philipp Treu leaves the pitch and Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) comes on.
49' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
46' Substitution. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) in, Adam Hlozek out.
46' The whistle blows and Sascha Stegemann starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

43' Well-positioned Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Nikola Vasilj reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
41' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
40' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
37' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
28' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
26' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' 0 - 1 Spectacular goal! Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
17' The possession of the ball – 72:28.

14' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Nikola Vasilj. This effort really didn't trouble him.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
7' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
2' A cross into the box from Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and St. Pauli will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann was nominated as the referee for this game.
